business_objective: Coordinate peer review of learning-activity drafts and close each exchange after completed feedback is acknowledged.

stakeholder_statements.text: A learner submits a draft for a learning activity and identifies the activity.
The course facilitator assigns a peer reviewer to the submitted draft.
The peer reviewer records feedback and marks the review complete.
The learner records acknowledgement after receiving the completed review.
The course tutor closes the exchange only after the review is complete and learner acknowledgement is recorded. Grading the draft and investigating plagiarism are outside this project.

business_objective: Register incoming care referrals, record service eligibility, and communicate whether each referral is accepted for assessment or returned.

stakeholder_statements.text: A referring clinic clerk submits a referral and identifies the patient reference, requested service, and referring clinician.
The referral intake officer records the referral as received and checks that the mandatory fields are present.
The service eligibility clerk records whether the requested service is handled by the receiving clinic.
The referral coordinator records the referral as accepted for assessment or returned and adds a reason when it is returned.
The correspondence clerk sends the recorded outcome to the referring clinic and closes the referral intake after dispatch. Clinical diagnosis and appointment scheduling are outside this project.

business_objective: Review and apply customer requests to correct gift messages before order processing makes the message ineligible for editing.

stakeholder_statements.text: A customer submits a gift-message correction and identifies the order and replacement message.
The order support agent records whether package processing has begun. The editable order stages have not been agreed.
The content reviewer records the replacement message as accepted or returned and adds a reason when it is returned. The prohibited-content categories are not finalized.
The fulfillment editor updates the gift message only when the order stage permits editing and the replacement message is accepted.
The customer communications clerk sends the correction outcome to the customer, but the delivery channel is undecided. Refunds and recipient address changes are outside this project.

business_objective: Record public-tree concerns, document inspection findings, and refer recommended intervention to a responsible service team.

stakeholder_statements.text: A resident reports a concern about a public tree and identifies the tree location and observed issue.
The service intake officer records a service priority for the concern. The priority rule has not been agreed.
The field inspector records the tree condition and whether intervention is recommended.
The works coordinator creates an action referral only when intervention is recommended and records the responsible service team. The rule for selecting the service team is undecided.
The resident liaison sends the inspection outcome to the resident, but the delivery channel is undecided. Work on private-property trees and emergency dispatch are outside this project.

business_objective: Review employee outside-work disclosures while preserving an unresolved rule about visibility of the external organization's identity.

stakeholder_statements.text: An employee submits an outside-work disclosure and identifies the external role, external organization, and planned start date.
The line manager records the operational impact of the outside work. The manager says the external organization's name must be visible to the manager during review.

The ethics reviewer records a conflict assessment and any restrictions. The reviewer says the line manager should see only the organization type, not its name, unless the employee agrees. The conflict categories are not finalized.
The HR case officer records any restriction communicated to the employee and records the employee's acknowledgement.

The HR compliance officer records an approved or declined decision after the operational-impact assessment, ethics assessment, and employee acknowledgement are present. Nobody has decided who may authorize disclosure of the external organization's name or the maximum decision time. Payroll processing and performance appraisal are outside this project; the meeting also spent time comparing lunch menus.
